title: API Access
content:
Connect ClinicPro to your existing tools with secure API access. Sync patient data, automate workflows, and build custom integrations that fit how your clinic already works.

  • REST API for core clinic data
  • Secure authentication and scoped access
  • Ideal for labs, billing, and custom portals
meta_description: Integrate ClinicPro with your systems using secure API access.
